title: TrustMed-RL: Long-Horizon Reinforcement Learning for Evidence-Grounded Clinical Diagnosis
summary: Medical language models can produce correct diagnoses despite incomplete investigations and unsupported reasoning. To support long-horizon, evidence-grounded diagnosis, we introduce \textbf{TrustMed-RL}. Built from PubMed rare-disease cases and over 24,000 manually annotated image panels, it integrates interviews, examinations, testing, specialist consultation, and literature search through state-dependent actions. Our 8B vision--language policy, trained with clinically adapted GiGPO and coverage-adjusted diagnostic rewards, achieves 37.1\% diagnostic accuracy on 2,500 evaluation cases, outperforming all evaluated open-weight baselines and improving over supervised fine-tuning by 12.4 percentage points.. When success additionally requires acquiring at least 50\% of supporting test evidence, TrustMed-RL achieves 32.5\%, exceeding GPT-4o by 6.8 percentage points. Furthermore, it surpasses all evaluated baselines on MTMedDialog and multiple larger 27--32B models on AgentClinic. In physician review of 200 diagnostically accepted test-set trajectories, 83.0\% receive evidential-grounding scores of 4--5 out of 5. Physicians' assessments suggest that these diagnostic trajectories are trustworthy and aligned with human diagnostic reasoning.
tldr: TrustMed-RL trains an 8B vision-language medical agent for long-horizon, evidence-grounded clinical diagnosis using clinically adapted GiGPO and coverage-adjusted diagnostic rewards. It integrates interviews, examinations, testing, specialist consultation, and literature search, achieving higher diagnostic accuracy than open-weight baselines and GPT-4o under evidence-requiring evaluation, with physician-verified trustworthy trajectories.
tldr_zh: TrustMed-RL 通过临床适配的 GiGPO 和覆盖调整的诊断奖励，训练一个 8B 视觉-语言医疗智能体，用于长周期、有证据支撑的临床诊断。它整合了问诊、检查、检验、专科会诊和文献检索，在需要证据支持的评价条件下优于开放权重基线和 GPT-4o，并得到医生的可信轨迹评估。
summary_zh: 医学语言模型即便在检查不完整、推理缺乏充分依据的情况下，也可能产生正确的诊断结果。为了支持长程、基于证据的诊断，我们提出了\textbf{TrustMed-RL}。该系统基于PubMed罕见病病例和超过24,000个手动标注的图像面板构建，通过状态依赖动作整合了问诊、检查、检验、专科会诊和文献检索。我们使用临床适配的GiGPO和覆盖度调整的诊断奖励训练的8B视觉-语言策略，在2,500个评估病例上达到了37.1\%的诊断准确率，优于所有评估过的开放权重基线，并比监督微调提高了12.4个百分点。当成功标准额外要求获取至少50\%的支持性检验证据时，TrustMed-RL达到了32.5\%，超过GPT-4o达6.8个百分点。此外，它在MTMedDialog上优于所有评估基线，并在AgentClinic上优于多个更大的27--32B模型。在对200条诊断正确的测试集轨迹进行医生评审中，83.0\%的轨迹在证据依据评分中获得了4--5分（满分5分）。医生的评估表明，这些诊断轨迹是可信的，并与人类诊断推理一致。

title: An End-to-End Framework for Modelling Pneumatic Soft Robots Based on Differentiable Finite Element Methods
summary: Soft robots present significant modelling challenges due to their non-linearity, complex dynamics and potentially intricate geometries. These difficulties in accurate system identification and dynamics modelling limit their applications in precise robotics tasks. Prior modelling approaches typically suffer from trade-offs in accuracy, computational efficiency, or speed. The differentiable finite element method (FEM) offers a promising balance between these desiderata for soft robot modelling, and enables the use of gradients for efficient calibration and trajectory optimisation. In this paper, we propose an end-to-end differentiable FEM-based framework designed to streamline modelling and system identification for pneumatic soft robots, enabling the generation of reliable models for downstream tasks. The framework automates the conversion of computer-aided designs into voxelised tetrahedral viscoelastic FEM meshes that accurately represent the robot's geometry and actuation mechanism. By integrating easily acquired point cloud data with differentiable FEM, the framework achieves precise identification of material and dynamic actuation parameters using a minimal experimental setup. Additionally, the differentiable nature of the model facilitates trajectory optimisation by leveraging gradients from robot dynamics and contact interactions. We validate the framework by modelling a complex bellow-shaped pneumatic soft robot and demonstrate its efficacy in real-world motion planning tasks. Experimental results indicate high modelling accuracy, with a maximum positional error of less than 3 mm, and successful application in tasks such as path following and grasping.
tldr: Proposes an end-to-end differentiable FEM framework for pneumatic soft robots, automating CAD-to-mesh conversion and calibrating material/dynamic parameters from point cloud data, while enabling trajectory optimisation via gradients. It is validated on a bellow-shaped soft robot with under 3 mm positional error and successful path-following and grasping tasks.
tldr_zh: 提出一个端到端可微有限元框架，用于气动软体机器人的建模与系统辨识，自动化从CAD到体网格生成，利用点云数据校准材料与驱动参数，并支持基于梯度的轨迹优化。在波纹管状软体机器人上验证，最大位置误差小于3mm，并成功用于路径跟踪与抓取任务。
summary_zh: 摘要：软体机器人由于其非线性、复杂动力学及潜在复杂的几何形状，给建模带来了重大挑战。这些在精确系统辨识和动力学建模方面的困难限制了其在精密机器人任务中的应用。先前的建模方法通常需要在精度、计算效率或速度之间进行权衡。可微有限元方法（FEM）为软体机器人建模在这些需求之间提供了一种有前景的平衡，并能利用梯度实现高效的参数校准和轨迹优化。在本文中，我们提出了一种基于可微有限元方法的端到端框架，旨在简化气动软体机器人的建模和系统辨识，从而为下游任务生成可靠的模型。该框架自动将计算机辅助设计转换为体素化四面体粘弹性有限元网格，以准确表示机器人的几何形状和驱动机制。通过将易于获取的点云数据与可微有限元方法相结合，该框架利用最少的实验装置即可实现材料和动态驱动参数的精确辨识。此外，模型的可微特性有助于利用来自机器人动力学和接触交互的梯度进行轨迹优化。我们通过对一个复杂的波纹管状气动软体机器人进行建模来验证该框架，并展示了其在真实世界运动规划任务中的有效性。实验结果表明，该框架具有较高的建模精度，最大位置误差小于3毫米，并在路径跟踪和抓取等任务中得到了成功应用。

title: Trajectory-Derived Confidence for Reliable, Resource-Aware Clinical Text-to-SQL Agents
summary: LLM agents for clinical text-to-SQL applications reason autonomously over multiple steps but cannot assess whether their own reasoning or outputs can be trusted. In high leverage applications such as healthcare, this presents a critical risk where system mistakes can be costly. These reliability failures are also resource failures: an incorrect reasoning trajectory spends computation budget on outputs that must be discarded. We introduce Sentinel, a trajectory-derived, classifier-based confidence layer that analyzes an agent's reasoning, code and database outputs to decide at three points whether to stop: refusing unanswerable questions before the agent runs, halting doomed trajectories mid-run, and withholding untrustworthy answers at delivery. Here, utilizing Chow's rule, we optimize decisions under the EHRSQL shared task's Reliability Score, which penalizes incorrect answers given a utility weighting, and find on the benchmark EHRSQL that Sentinel raises this score from +0.08 to +0.24 when mistakes have a low utility weighting, well above the +0.03 earned by refusing every question, with delivered-answer accuracy rising from 54% to 69% as coverage falls from 84% to 55%. At higher stakes the agents we test rarely answer reliably enough to deliver, and Sentinel detects this on its own, abstaining to that same +0.03 where the unmonitored agent scores -3.02. The same stopping decisions cut computation: at low stakes, where the system still answers, Sentinel eliminates 13-28% of agent steps at little or no reliability cost.
tldr: Sentinel is a classifier-based confidence layer that monitors an LLM agent's reasoning, code, and database outputs for clinical text-to-SQL, deciding at three stages whether to stop. It improves reliability and delivered-answer accuracy on EHRSQL while cutting computation steps.
tldr_zh: Sentinel 是一个基于轨迹的置信度层，用于临床文本到 SQL 的 LLM 代理，在运行前、运行中和交付前三个节点决定是否停止，从而提升可靠性并节省计算资源。在 EHRSQL 上显著改善可靠性评分和答案准确率，同时减少代理步骤。
summary_zh: LLM智能体在临床文本到SQL应用中会自主进行多步推理，但无法评估自身推理或输出是否可信。在医疗保健等高杠杆应用中，这构成了关键风险，因为系统错误可能代价高昂。这些可靠性失败也是资源浪费：错误的推理轨迹在最终必须丢弃的输出上消耗了计算预算。我们引入了Sentinel，一种基于轨迹、分类器的置信度层，它分析智能体的推理、代码和数据库输出，并在三个决策点决定是否停止：在智能体运行前拒绝无法回答的问题，在运行中途终止注定失败的轨迹，以及在交付时扣留不可信的回答。此处，利用Chow规则，我们根据EHRSQL共享任务的可靠性得分（该得分在效用加权下惩罚错误回答）优化决策，并在EHRSQL基准上发现：当错误具有较低效用权重时，Sentinel将该得分从+0.08提升至+0.24，远高于拒绝所有问题所得的+0.03；同时，交付答案的准确率从54%提升至69%，而覆盖率从84%降至55%。在更高风险情境下，我们测试的智能体很少能足够可靠地回答以进行交付，而Sentinel能自行检测到这一点，并弃权至同样的+0.03，而未经监控的智能体得分则为-3.02。相同的停止决策还削减了计算量：在系统仍会回答的低风险情境下，Sentinel以极少或零可靠性代价消除了13-28%的智能体步骤。

title: FloVMos: Optical Flow-based Medical Video Mosaicking
summary: Biomedical imaging modalities often require a trade-off among resolution, field of view (FOV), and acquisition speed. Video mosaicking offers a strategy to overcome this limitation by computationally stitching sequential high-resolution frames into a wide-FOV composite. However, existing methods struggle with non-rigid deformations, and modality-specific artifacts arising in clinical and research imaging. Here, we present FloVMos, a generalizable, optical-flow-based deep learning framework for real-time video mosaicking across diverse biomedical imaging modalities. FloVMos achieves robust, pixel-level registration by fine-tuning an optical flow model on synthetic training data with ground-truth deformation fields. We introduce a pipeline for generating this training data, simulating realistic tissue motion and imaging distortions from existing mosaics or raw videos. Our automated synthetic data generation and optical flow model training based on this data allow users to adapt FloVMos to different imaging modalities. To demonstrate this, we applied FloVMos to seven diverse imaging modalities: reflection confocal microscopy, open-top light-sheet microscopy, fetoscopy, laparoscopy, dermoscopy, sparse spectral microscopy, and endoscopy. FloVMos outperforms conventional baselines in accuracy, robustness, and speed for all the tested modalities. This adaptable and training-efficient framework enables large-area visualization with real-time performance and may support broader use of video-based biomedical imaging in research and clinical workflows.
tldr: Presents FloVMos, an optical-flow-based deep learning framework for real-time video mosaicking across seven biomedical imaging modalities, using synthetic training data with ground-truth deformation fields for adaptation and robust pixel-level registration.
tldr_zh: 提出了FloVMos，一种基于光流的深度学习视频拼接框架，利用带真实形变场的合成训练数据实现跨七种生物医学成像模态的鲁棒像素级配准与实时拼接。
summary_zh: 生物医学成像模式通常需要在分辨率、视场（FOV）和采集速度之间进行权衡。视频拼接提供了一种克服这一限制的策略，通过计算方式将连续的高分辨率帧拼接成宽视场合成图像。然而，现有方法难以处理非刚性变形以及临床和研究成像中出现的模态特异性伪影。在此，我们提出了FloVMos，一种基于光流的可泛化深度学习框架，用于跨多种生物医学成像模式的实时视频拼接。FloVMos通过在具有真实变形场的合成训练数据上微调光流模型，实现了稳健的像素级配准。我们引入了一个生成此类训练数据的流程，模拟来自现有拼接图或原始视频的真实组织运动和成像畸变。基于这些数据，我们的自动化合成数据生成和光流模型训练使用户能够将FloVMos适配到不同的成像模式。为证明这一点，我们将FloVMos应用于七种不同的成像模式：反射共聚焦显微镜、开放式光片显微镜、胎儿镜、腹腔镜、皮肤镜、稀疏光谱显微镜和内窥镜。在所有测试模式中，FloVMos在准确性、鲁棒性和速度方面均优于传统基线方法。这种适应性强的、训练高效的框架能够实现具有实时性能的大面积可视化，并可能支持基于视频的生物医学成像在研究和临床流程中的更广泛应用。

title: Data-Driven Modeling and Predictive Control of Chronic Diseases: An Ulcerative Colitis Application
summary: The clinical management of chronic disease is naturally structured as a feedback control problem. Physicians observe the disease state at clinic visits and make decisions based on the patient's history and current state. We propose a framework that models the dynamics of chronic disease in response to therapy as an event-based controlled stochastic system, in which treatment decisions are made at discrete, irregularly spaced events while the disease evolves between events as a continuous-time Markov chain (CTMC) with state and input dependent transition rates. We demonstrate this framework in the setting of ulcerative colitis, where we identify the model from real-world clinical data in the electronic health record (EHR) of more than 3,000 patients with ulcerative colitis. Using the learned model, we formulate therapy selection as a model predictive control problem (MPC) that maximizes the expected time spent in inactive disease states, and we evaluate the resulting policy. In closed-loop simulation on 10 patients, the MPC achieves a cost at or below the observed clinical course in the majority of its realizations for 4 of the 10 patients, and its outcomes in all cases are comparable to observed care and within clinical guidelines.
tldr: Treats chronic disease management as a feedback control problem, models ulcerative colitis dynamics as a continuous-time Markov chain with treatment-dependent transition rates learned from EHR data, and applies model predictive control for therapy selection; closed-loop simulations show outcomes comparable to or better than observed care for some patients.
tldr_zh: 将慢性病管理视为反馈控制问题，利用电子健康档案数据将溃疡性结肠炎动力学建模为治疗相关的连续时间马尔可夫链，并用模型预测控制选择治疗方案；在10名患者的闭环模拟中，MPC结果与临床观察相当或更优。
summary_zh: 慢性病的临床管理天然可被建模为一个反馈控制问题。医生在门诊时观察疾病状态，并根据患者病史和当前状态做出决策。我们提出一个框架，将慢性病对治疗响应的动态过程建模为基于事件的受控随机系统，其中治疗决策在离散、不规则间隔的事件节点做出，而疾病在事件之间则作为连续时间马尔可夫链（CTMC）演化，其转移率依赖于状态和输入。我们在溃疡性结肠炎的场景中展示了该框架，利用电子健康记录（EHR）中超过3000名溃疡性结肠炎患者的真实临床数据识别模型。基于学习得到的模型，我们将治疗选择表述为模型预测控制（MPC）问题，该问题最大化预期处于非活动疾病状态的时间，并评估所得策略。在对10名患者的闭环模拟中，MPC在10名患者中的4名的大部分实现中，其成本达到或低于观察到的临床过程，且所有情况下的结果均与观察到的治疗相当，并符合临床指南。

title: Label Agreement Does Not Measure Authorization
summary: Many groups now delegate label ontology and metadata harmonization to agentic LLM pipelines. We built one and audited it. Our aggregate scores looked healthy, but the pipeline kept failing in ways they did not show, so we set out to find what they hid. Label agreement asks whether a proposed label matches a reference. It does not ask whether the agent was entitled to propose it, whether the output was complete enough to act on, or whether the label moved when the evidence moved. We measured those three separately on COBRE and FBIRN, two schizophrenia and control neuroimaging cohorts from different consortia, and they come apart, from label agreement and from each other. Showing the agent an upstream proposal barely moves label agreement, 0.857 to 0.870, while agreement on the chosen action doubles, 0.409 to 0.830. Output that parses as JSON still drops a required field on 10% of one model's cases and 33% of the other's. And an agent that replays its first answer scores perfectly on original cases and zero once we change the evidence that decides them. Downstream, a row-order error that none of these metrics reports erases most of the diagnostic signal. So we measure these properties apart, pair each with a control, and gate commitment on the result, which makes failures visible and easy to route to a person. None of this prevents failure. Our reference labels are rule-derived, so agreement with them means consistency, not correctness. Code is available at https://github.com/amir-sbg/Label-Agreement-Does-Not-Measure-Authorization.
tldr: The authors audit an agentic LLM pipeline for label harmonization in neuroimaging and show that standard label-agreement metrics hide critical failures. They propose separately measuring authorization, completeness, and evidence sensitivity, each with controls, so failures become visible and can be routed to humans.
tldr_zh: 作者审计了一个用于神经影像标签协调的智能体LLM流水线，指出标签一致性指标掩盖了关键失败。他们提出分别衡量授权、完整性和证据敏感性，并配合对照设计，使失败可见并便于转交人工处理。
summary_zh: 许多团队现在将标签本体和元数据协调工作委托给智能体化的大语言模型流水线。我们构建了这样一个流水线并对其进行了审计。我们的总体分数看起来不错，但流水线仍以这些分数未暴露的方式不断失败，因此我们着手探究这些分数究竟掩盖了什么。标签一致性检查的是提议标签是否与参考标签匹配，而不检查智能体是否有权提出该标签、输出是否足够完整以支持后续行动，以及标签是否随证据变化而变化。我们在COBRE和FBIRN两个来自不同联盟的精神分裂症与对照神经影像队列上分别测量了这三个属性，结果它们彼此之间以及它们与标签一致性之间都存在明显差异。向智能体展示上游提议几乎不改变标签一致性（从0.857到0.870），但所选动作的一致性却翻倍（从0.409到0.830）。能解析为JSON的输出仍会漏掉必需字段：在一个模型的10%用例和另一个模型的33%用例中发生。此外，一个重复其首次回答的智能体在原始用例上得分完美，但一旦我们改变决定答案的证据，得分即为零。在下游任务中，一个这些指标均未报告的行序错误抹除了大部分诊断信号。因此，我们分别测量这些属性，为每个属性设置对照，并根据结果对承诺进行把关，从而使失败可见并易于转交人工处理。这些措施都不能阻止失败。我们的参考标签由规则推导得出，因此与它们的一致意味着一致性，而非正确性。代码可在 https://github.com/amir-sbg/Label-Agreement-Does-Not-Measure-Authorization 获取。

title: A Guidewire Trajectory Generation Tool for Interventional MRI Simulations
summary: Significance: RF-induced heating of endovascular devices limits MRI-guided interventions, including targeted drug delivery to brain tumors. Purpose: To present a tool that rapidly generates randomized guidewire trajectories for RF heating risk assessment. Methods: A MATLAB tool models the guidewire as a spline with randomized control nodes and a fixed nominal length. As a use case, tip sSAR was estimated for 1000 trajectories using straight-wire transfer functions and 64 MHz local and body coil fields (matched B1) in the Duke phantom. Results: Length accuracy was 99.84%, and 3000 trajectories were generated in 11.5 s. Body-to-local sSAR ratios at the 50th, 95th, and 99th percentiles were 1.5, 1.6, and 2.27, but some trajectories heated more under the local coil. Conclusion: The tool enables large-sample heating assessment, and coil type alone did not reliably predict individual trajectory risk.
tldr: This paper presents a MATLAB-based tool that rapidly generates randomized guidewire trajectories modeled as splines to assess RF-induced heating risk in interventional MRI. In a Duke phantom study, the tool produced thousands of trajectories with high length accuracy and showed that coil type alone did not reliably predict per-trajectory heating risk.
tldr_zh: 本文介绍了一个基于MATLAB的工具，用于快速生成随机导丝轨迹（样条模型），以评估介入MRI中射频引起的加热风险。在Duke体模实验中，该工具可快速生成数千条轨迹且长度精度高，并表明仅凭线圈类型无法可靠预测单条轨迹的加热风险。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
意义：血管内器械的射频致热限制了MRI引导的介入治疗，包括针对脑肿瘤的靶向药物递送。目的：提出一种快速生成随机导丝轨迹以进行射频发热风险评估的工具。方法：一个MATLAB工具将导丝建模为具有随机控制节点和固定标称长度的样条曲线。作为用例，使用直导线传递函数以及Duke体模中的64 MHz局部线圈和体线圈场（匹配B1），估算了1000条轨迹的尖端sSAR。结果：长度准确度为99.84%，3000条轨迹在11.5秒内生成。第50、95和99百分位数的体线圈与局部线圈sSAR比值分别为1.5、1.6和2.27，但某些轨迹在局部线圈下加热更严重。结论：该工具能够实现大样本发热评估，且仅凭线圈类型无法可靠预测个体轨迹风险。

title: Localization Lens for Improving Medical Vision-Language Models
summary: Medical Vision-Language Models (Med-VLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in clinical tasks. However, they often struggle to understand anatomical structures and spatial positioning, which are crucial for medical reasoning. To address this, we propose a localization-aware enhancement to the Med-VLM pipeline, introducing improvements at three levels: data,architecture, and alignment. First, we introduce localization lens, a set of expert-validated representations that provide richer anatomical and positional context. However, as these representations increase input complexity, we integrate pixel shuffle within the model architecture to filter and refine representations, enhancing spatial information processing while preserving anatomical continuity. Lastly, to effectively align the localization lens representations with textual features, we incorporate decoupled contrastive loss (DCL) alongside the standard loss function. This ensures better feature discrimination and robustness, particularly in data limited medical settings. Through extensive evaluations on medical visual question answering (Med-VQA) datasets, we show that our methodology improves localization-driven performance across different Med-VLM architectures. Our analysis of localization-based questions further reveals that improvements in anatomy and spatial reasoning directly enhance the overall accuracy of Med-VQA upto 6.2%. The proposed approach is model-agnostic and can be seamlessly integrated into existing Med-VLM pipelines. The dataset, code, and trained models will be made publicly available at https://github.com/CVLABLUMS/localizationlens.
tldr: Proposes a localization-aware enhancement for medical vision-language models using expert-validated localization lens representations, pixel shuffle in the architecture, and decoupled contrastive loss to improve anatomical/spatial reasoning; achieves up to 6.2% accuracy gains on Med-VQA benchmarks across different model architectures.
tldr_zh: 提出一种面向医学视觉语言模型的位置感知增强方法，通过专家验证的定位透镜表示、像素重排架构改进以及解耦对比损失，提升模型对解剖结构和空间位置的理解；在Med-VQA基准上最高提升6.2%，且模型无关、易于集成。
summary_zh: 医学视觉语言模型（Med-VLMs）已在临床任务中展现出强大的能力。然而，它们常常难以理解解剖结构和空间定位，而这些对于医学推理至关重要。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种定位感知增强方法，应用于Med-VLM流程，并在三个层面引入改进：数据、架构和对齐。首先，我们引入定位透镜（localization lens），即一组经过专家验证的表示，提供更丰富的解剖和位置上下文。由于这些表示增加了输入复杂性，我们在模型架构中整合了像素重组（pixel shuffle），以过滤和精炼表示，增强空间信息处理，同时保持解剖连续性。最后，为了有效对齐定位透镜表示与文本特征，我们在标准损失函数之外引入了解耦对比损失（DCL），从而确保更好的特征判别性和鲁棒性，尤其是在数据有限的医疗场景中。通过在医学视觉问答（Med-VQA）数据集上的广泛评估，我们表明所提出的方法在不同Med-VLM架构中均能提升定位驱动的性能。基于定位问题的分析进一步表明，解剖与空间推理的改进直接提升了Med-VQA的整体准确率，最高达6.2%。所提出的方法具有模型无关性，可无缝集成到现有Med-VLM流程中。数据集、代码和训练模型将在 https://github.com/CVLABLUMS/localizationlens 公开提供。

title: Homogeneous Semantic Alignment and Hierarchical Expert Routing for Radiology Report Generation
summary: Radiology report generation (RRG) aims to convert medical images into diagnostic texts to assist in clinical decision-making and alleviate the workload of physicians. Although existing methods have made extensive progress in cross-modal interaction and the incorporation of external priors, the distribution shift of underlying representations and the undifferentiated rigid coupling of heterogeneous information cause weak visual abnormality cues to be easily diluted by massive text priors and generation inertia during decoding. To overcome this bottleneck, inspired by cognitive science, we propose a novel two-stage Homogeneous Semantic Alignment and Hierarchical Expert Routing (HSA-HER) framework. First, the model introduces an explicit homogeneous distribution constraint in the underlying latent space to effectively eliminate the cross-modal distribution shift between visual and textual features, thereby extracting purified visual features as semantic anchors that accurately align with diseases. Second, for heterogeneous clinical evidence composed of visual features, local entities, and global retrievals, we design a hierarchical expert routing mechanism guided by these disease semantic anchors. This mechanism abandons the undifferentiated rigid coupling paradigm. Specifically, it dynamically activates expert networks to perform targeted mining and semantic reconstruction on multi-source evidence, and adaptively allocates fusion weights. Extensive experiments on three mainstream benchmark datasets demonstrate that HSA-HER achieves state-of-the-art performance, accurately depicting complex imaging details and key diagnostic information.
tldr: Proposes a two-stage radiology report generation framework that aligns visual and textual features in a homogeneous latent space to obtain disease-anchored visual semantics, then uses a hierarchical expert routing mechanism to dynamically fuse visual, entity, and retrieval evidence. Achieves state-of-the-art results on three mainstream RRG benchmarks.
tldr_zh: 提出一种两阶段放射学报告生成框架：先在统一潜在空间中对齐视觉与文本特征，以疾病语义锚点提取纯净视觉特征；再通过层次化专家路由机制动态融合视觉、局部实体和全局检索等多源证据。在三个主流基准上取得SOTA结果。
summary_zh: 放射学报告生成（RRG）旨在将医学图像转换为诊断文本，以辅助临床决策并减轻医生工作负担。尽管现有方法在跨模态交互和外部先验知识融入方面取得了广泛进展，但底层表征的分布偏移以及异质信息的无差别刚性耦合，导致微弱的视觉异常线索在解码过程中容易被海量文本先验和生成惯性所稀释。为突破这一瓶颈，受认知科学启发，我们提出了一种新颖的两阶段同质语义对齐与层次化专家路由（HSA-HER）框架。首先，该模型在底层潜在空间中引入显式的同质分布约束，有效消除视觉与文本特征之间的跨模态分布偏移，从而提取纯净的视觉特征作为与疾病精准对齐的语义锚点。其次，针对由视觉特征、局部实体和全局检索组成的异质临床证据，我们设计了一种由疾病语义锚点引导的层次化专家路由机制。该机制摒弃了无差别的刚性耦合范式，具体而言，它动态激活专家网络对多源证据进行定向挖掘和语义重建，并自适应地分配融合权重。在三个主流基准数据集上的大量实验表明，HSA-HER取得了最先进的性能，能够准确刻画复杂的影像细节和关键诊断信息。
